questiontext.text:
Given the following information

\(\displaystyle w={@func_w@}\)

\(\displaystyle x={@func_x@}\)

\(\displaystyle y={@func_y@}\)

\(\displaystyle z={@func_z@}\)

\(\displaystyle p={@func_p@}\)

We can use Chain Rule to determine \( \displaystyle \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{t}}\) and \( \displaystyle \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{s}}\) as follows;

\(\displaystyle \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{t}} = \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{x}}\frac{\partial{x}}{\partial{p}}\frac{d{p}}{d{t}}+ \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{y}}\frac{\partial{y}}{\partial{p}}\frac{d{p}}{d{t}}+ \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{y}}\frac{\partial{y}}{\partial{t}}+ \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{z}}\frac{\partial{z}}{\partial{t}}\)

\(\displaystyle \quad = \) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]


\(\displaystyle \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{s}}= \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{y}}\frac{\partial{y}}{\partial{s}}+\frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{z}}\frac{\partial{z}}{\partial{s}}\)

\(\displaystyle \quad = \) [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

We need to compute the partial derivates of the following functions as shown,

\(\displaystyle \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{x}}= {@diff_wx@}\) \(\displaystyle\frac{\partial{x}}{\partial{p}}= {@diff_xp@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{\partial{p}}{\partial{t}}= {@diff_pt@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{y}}= {@diff_wy@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{\partial{y}}{\partial{p}}= {@diff_yp@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{\partial{y}}{\partial{t}}= {@diff_yt@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{z}}= {@diff_wz@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{\partial{z}}{\partial{t}}= {@diff_zt@}\)

Then substitute them in the formulas below,

\(\displaystyle \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{t}} = \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{x}}\frac{\partial{x}}{\partial{p}}\frac{\partial{p}}{\partial{t}}+ \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{y}}\frac{\partial{y}}{\partial{p}}\frac{\partial{p}}{\partial{t}}+ \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{y}}\frac{\partial{y}}{\partial{t}}+ \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{z}}\frac{\partial{z}}{\partial{t}}\)

\(\displaystyle \quad = {@ta1@}\)


\( \displaystyle \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{s}}= \frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{y}}\frac{\partial{y}}{\partial{s}}+\frac{\partial{w}}{\partial{z}}\frac{\partial{z}}{\partial{s}}\)

\(\displaystyle \quad = {@ta1@}\)
